key_path: Sign up at airtable.com with Google/Apple OAuth or email (email signup requires verification)
Onboarding creates a workspace (skip the base wizard)
Open deep link https://airtable.com/create/tokens/new?scopes=data.records:read,data.records:write,schema.bases:read,... (scopes pre-selected), pick bases/workspaces, Create, copy PAT
Call https://api.airtable.com/v0/meta/bases with Bearer PAT (or 'airtable-mcp whoami')
human_gates_notes: Email gate avoided with Google OAuth. Enterprise admins can restrict third-party integrations/MCP.

agent_native_auth.cli_device_login: partial - @airtable/mcp-cli exists but auth is paste-a-PAT ('airtable-mcp configure'), no browser login
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: yes - granular scopes + per-base/workspace resource selection
agent_native_auth.free_tier_or_sandbox: yes - MCP 'available to all users on all plans'

remote.auth: OAuth via DCR (default), static OAuth client, or PAT as Authorization Bearer header

mcp.local: CLI 'airtable-mcp' calls MCP tools from terminal (npm @airtable/mcp-cli)
mcp.one_click_install: yes - Claude directory link, Claude Code plugin deep link (claude-cli://... plugin install airtable@claude-plugins-official), ChatGPT app link, Gemini

docs_for_agents.ai_page: https://airtable.com/developers/agents (Quickstart, MCP per client, Controls, Skills)
docs_for_agents.agents_md_or_rules: yes - published agent skills (overview, filters, CLI, product/sales/marketing ops)

score_justification: Dedicated 'agents' doc section, DCR + PAT-bearer MCP, prefilled-scope token deep link, skills, and directory listings in Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini.
best_practice: Token-creation deep link with the exact MCP scopes pre-selected in the query string - the human only clicks Create.
biggest_gap: No llms-full.txt or official OpenAPI spec for the REST API; CLI has no browser/device login.
